fields.name: title
fields.description: The descriptive name or heading for the event log.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A human-readable explanation of the event.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The type of event being logged.
fields.synonyms: event type, event category, kind, status

fields.name: date
fields.description: The timestamp associated with the event.

fields.name: allEntries
fields.description: An array of log entry objects.

fields.name: entries
fields.description: A list of log entries, each with associated data.

fields.name: filterChips
fields.description: Represents selectable filter options for event categories.

fields.name: filterKind
fields.description: The type of filter currently applied to the event log.

fields.name: backfillTitle
fields.description: A descriptive title for a manually added event.
fields.synonyms: manual title, user-provided title, custom title

fields.name: backfillDescription
fields.description: A textual explanation for the event backfill process.

fields.name: backfillDate
fields.description: The date and time when the event was manually added.

fields.name: backfillKind
fields.description: Specifies the category or type of the manually added event.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: A human-readable message indicating an error condition.

events.name: APPLY_FILTER
events.description: Signals a filter has been applied to the event log.

events.name: OPEN_BACKFILL
events.description: Initiates a backfill operation to retrieve historical events.

events.name: SAVE_BACKFILL
events.description: Indicates successful completion of backfill data saving.

events.name: EventLogLoaded
events.description: Signals the event log has finished loading.

events.name: EventLogLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates that loading the event log failed.

events.name: EventLogSaved
events.description: Indicates a new event has been successfully logged.

events.name: EventLogSaveFailed
events.description: Indicates that saving an event failed.

events.name: REFETCH_QUERY
events.description: Triggers an activity feed refresh based on the current search term.

events.name: REFETCH_FILTER
events.description: Triggers an activity feed refresh based on a field/value filter, in addition to the built-in kind tabs.

events.name: REFETCH_PAGE
events.description: Triggers an activity feed page refresh.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the log's own search box?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Embeds a search box above the activity feed. Set true only when the page has no other search affordance (e.g. no page-level std-search), so the surface shows one search box instead of two. False is the default — no consumer of this atom has ever had a search box.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline search, log search, built-in search, show search

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for cards rendered by this atom.

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many entries per page should a pager show?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Page size a consumer-composed std-pagination control should use to compute total pages (e.g. from totalCount). This atom's own timeline pattern has no built-in pager UI, so this knob is informational for the composed control, not consumed by the timeline itself.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: visible rows, items per page, display limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Filter bar look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which filters should appear above the feed?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the timeline; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait, ANDed with the current kind tab. Empty (the default) = no filter bar — the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this atom and routes XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER, or relies solely on the built-in kind-filter chips (driven by kindOptions, which this knob does not duplicate or replace). Use this knob only for an extra facet beyond kind (e.g. actor, priority).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

overridableConfigKeys.label: Backfill fields
overridableConfigKeys.description: Inputs shown in the form for manually logging missed events

overridableConfigKeys.label: Event kinds
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maps each event kind to its label, icon, and status color

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many entries per page when paging?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Records fetched from the server per REFETCH_PAGE request. The initial load and every search/kind/filter refetch stay unpaginated (load everything that matches) so the default unlimited activity feed is unchanged; only an explicit REFETCH_PAGE from a composed std-pagination control applies this limit.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, page limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search box placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hint text inside the log's search box.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text

overridableConfigKeys.label: Timeline look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the timeline.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Section title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the activity timeline
